VoxNav Preferences

Universal Voice Navigation Configuration

🎙️ Voice & Speech

Speech recognition dialect used for listening and spoken intent parsing.
Audibly confirms when buttons are clicked, forms filled, or errors occur.

🧭 Navigation & On-Page UI

Displays a sleek, draggable microphone pill in the corner of webpages.
Overlays numbers on all interactive elements automatically for quick "Click 3" commands.
Asks "Say Confirm to proceed" before deleting, paying, or submitting sensitive orders.

🧠 AI Model & Reasoning

Uses an LLM when commands require complex reasoning (e.g. "Find the cheapest laptop").
Stored locally in your secure Chrome sync storage. Never shared.

🔒 Privacy & Data Protection

Explicitly shows a glowing red dot whenever the microphone is capturing audio.
Only sends non-sensitive button labels to the AI provider. Form values and passwords are never transmitted.

🧪 Voice Playground (Try it here!)

You can test VoxNav commands right on this page! Click the mic widget or say commands like: "Click Start Free", "Select Premium", or "Show numbers".

Interactive target test area ready.
